description: Direct offline evaluation of the checked-in PR9/PR10 search-quality fixtures via `tracedecay-search-eval`. No network, no model runtime, no owner receipts, gates, packets, or attestation. Provenance digests are recorded as evidence, never as promotion gates.

steps.detail: All fixture bytes and canonical digests match the frozen manifest; authority is contract_only.

Real CompositionKernel exact/lexical/graph lanes plus the production semantic path (offline PR9 fallback) produced deterministic candidate bytes. Sealed holdout input carries queries only, never labels. Resource/latency samples are machine-local and emitted at run time; they are not frozen here.

blocked_on.reason: direct filesystem locked-quality holdout labels with canonical digests are required

steps.detail: The checked-in fixtures are contract_only authority; authoritative direct holdout labels are intentionally not committed, so no accept/reject quality conclusion is produced. Run compare with --holdout-labels and --saved-candidates against a locked-quality run to reach an Accepted or Rejected outcome.

thresholds: None declared for these fixtures; metrics are reported with status recorded rather than judged against an invented bar.
conclusion: Direct evaluation flow runs end-to-end offline. Quality outcome is pending until direct holdout labels for a locked-quality run are supplied.
